meal.title: Extract attribute values from BeautifulSoup tags
meal.objective: Retrieve an attribute like src from a tag using dictionary‑style indexing

voice.script: Where does the video URL live in the HTML? How to grab a src attribute from a tag? You might see an iframe tag with a src attribute, but how do you pull that value out? In BeautifulSoup a tag works like a dictionary, so you can index it with the attribute name. For example, after locating the article element, you write video_src = article.find('iframe', class_='YouTube player')['src'] and then print(video_src) to see the link. Remember you can treat a tag like a dict to get its attributes. Now try extracting the href from each article link on your own.
